liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Sugaree** (1 review): Listener describes this performance of Sugaree as the best they have ever heard [29]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer praises the transition from Scarlet Begonias into Touch Of Grey, noting the crowd's reaction [30]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Reviewer praises the second set, specifically the sequence from Terrapin Station through Good Lovin' [28]
- **Bob Jam** (1 review): Listener highlights the performance of Bob Jam as the start of the show's best parts [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1985-10-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105882.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [1]
- **gd1985-10-28.sbd.miller.77370.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1985-10-28.158504.mtx.seamons.ht145.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 144 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1985-10-28.154408.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 143 min [4]
- **gd1985-10-28.set2-33P.moore.acohen.88156.flac16**: source not stated; 13 songs; 83 min; rated 1.5/5 by 4 [21]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes excessive high end and tinny, speaker-crackling quality in this audience recording [25]

## Around the show

- Reviewer recalls attending with friends in a small, well-appointed venue in Atlanta [32]
- Kansas City Royals were in the World Series during this performance [3]
- Kansas City Royals were in the World Series during this performance [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1985-10-28.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.105882.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Maxell MX90) [1]. Also: Tapes provided by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; pitch corrected by Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd1985-10-28.sbd.miller.77370.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/Maxell MX90) [2]. Also: Cassettes from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; second set sounds better than the first [2]
- **gd1985-10-28.158504.mtx.seamons.ht145.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC/24 > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity w/dither > FLAC/16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [3]. Also: Doug Oade's audience recording patches breaks; EQ matches the October 29th matrix [3]
- **gd1985-10-28.154408.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  August 22, 2021; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/Maxell MX90) [4]
- **gd1985-10-28.set2-33P.moore.acohen.88156.flac16**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by Anne Cohen, May 2007.; source: 2 Sony ECM-33P's > Sony TC-D5M (Dolby B)Maxell MX90 cassette [21]
